layers.name: Crawl
layers.title: The Draft
layers.text:
It is a dark time for the free world. Deep in the jungles of Vietnam, the Vietkong have hatched their most fiendish plot yet.

While on a completely unrelated experiment with LSD to see about its medical uses and ability to improve the brain's cognitive functions, our scientists found credible information to suggest that the Vietkong are planning to commit 911 roughly 50 years into the future.

That is where Bob comes in. We wanted the best and got the hero we deserve. Uncle Sam has drafted every able bodied man in the country, and found Bob to be somehow more able than the rest.

He got a C. on his physical. He got a B. on his IQ test. His cholesterol should be studied and his blood sugar is 50/50. He is a specimen among specimens and he is,

BOB

One more thing...  Bob,

layers.name: Last line
layers.text: Only you can stop 9/11 in 50 years!

13,33.text: Go into the side room to prepare
